content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Registered Dietician (RD) with M.Sc. (Food Science & Nutrition) OR M.Sc. (Clinical Nutrition & Dietetics). Minimum 01-year experience after Degree in relevant field. Candidates having experience in Oncology Nutrition will be given preference. Diploma in Electronics and Communication /Electrical and electronics with minimum 1 year experience OR ITI in Electronics/ Electrical with minimum 3 years experience in relevant field. The upper age limit is relaxed for persons belonging to Reserved Categories such as SC/ST/OBC, as per the instruction of Government of India. The notice also states that norms can be relaxed for deserving candidates with relevant experience. The monthly remuneration is Rs. 30,000/- To Rs.35,000/- for Assistant Dietician and Rs.23,870/- for ELV Technician. Each post is initially for a fixed tenure of one year from the date of joining. It may be extended subject to satisfactory performance and as per the institutional requirement. The posting will be at New Chandigarh or Sangrur as per institutional requirement. content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates should carry their Bio-data, a recent passport size photograph, PAN Card, Aadhar Card, and Educational and Experience Certificates in original, along with one set of self-attested copies. The original documents are for verification. The notice lists the following photocopies, to be submitted at the time of the interview: Resume and 2 recent passport size photographs (mandatory) Date of Birth Proof: Birth Certificate/School leaving Certificate/10th passing certificate Educational Qualification: Mark Sheet & passing certificate for final examinations Experience Certificate, past employment: experience certificate indicating the date of joining and relieving Experience Certificate, current employment: appointment letter and last pay slip PAN Card and Aadhar Card

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates attend directly at the venue on their post's walk-in date, between 09.30 am and 11.00 am. Candidates will not be entertained at the venue before or after the scheduled date and time. If more candidates turn up, an MCQ test will be conducted and eligible candidates will be shortlisted for the interview on that basis. The agency reserves the right to fix a minimum eligibility standard or benchmark and to restrict the number of candidates called for the written examination, interview or skill test. It may take into account factors such as the number of vacancies and the percentage of marks in graduate or post graduate degrees. It also reserves the right to fix minimum eligibility standards or cut-off marks (Group/Stream/Discipline/Category-wise etc.) when finalising the candidates called for the written test, interview or skill test. The decision of the competent Authority is final, and no correspondence about it will be entertained. Meeting the prescribed qualifications alone does not entitle an applicant to be called for the written test, interview or skill test.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: A candidate's candidature will be cancelled at any stage if he or she is found ineligible, has given incorrect, false or incomplete information, or has suppressed any material fact. If a shortcoming is detected even after appointment, the candidate's services are liable to be terminated forthwith. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature. The number of advertised posts may increase or decrease as per the requirement of the institute. For queries, contact [email protected] , 18005721201 or 01602810091 (EXTN: 3616).

rows.details: Official advertisement for Assistant Dietician and ELV Technician

faq.question: Q1. When is the HBCHRC Punjab walk-in interview in 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Assistant Dietician is on 5 November 2026, and the one for ELV Technician is on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the time and venue of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in runs between 09.30 am and 11.00 am at H.R.D Dept, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, New Chandigarh, Medicity, Mohali, Punjab- 140901.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 01 Assistant Dietician and 02 ELV Technician. The number of posts may increase or decrease as per the requirement of the institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Assistant Dietician?
faq.answer: The candidate must be a Registered Dietician (RD) with M.Sc. (Food Science & Nutrition) OR M.Sc. (Clinical Nutrition & Dietetics), with a minimum of 01 year of experience after the degree in a relevant field. Experience in Oncology Nutrition gets preference.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for ELV Technician?
faq.answer: The candidate needs a Diploma in Electronics and Communication /Electrical and electronics with minimum 1 year experience, OR an ITI in Electronics/ Electrical with minimum 3 years experience in relevant field.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit for both posts is up to 30 years as on the walk-in interview date. The upper age limit is relaxed for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per the instruction of Government of India.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for HBCHRC Punjab Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs. 30,000/- To Rs.35,000/- for Assistant Dietician and Rs.23,870/- for ELV Technician.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring your Bio-data or resume, 2 recent passport size photographs, date of birth proof, mark sheets and passing certificates, experience certificates, PAN Card and Aadhar Card. Carry them in original along with one set of self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by interview. If more candidates turn up, an MCQ test will be conducted and eligible candidates will be shortlisted for the interview on that basis.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job, and where is the posting?
faq.answer: No, it is not a permanent job. It is a contract job through M/s. Innovsource Services Pvt. Ltd., initially for a fixed tenure of one year that may be extended subject to satisfactory performance and institutional requirement. The posting will be at New Chandigarh or Sangrur.
